title: The most consequential task may determine the value of the whole job
text: The discussion explains why automating many tasks in a role does not settle the outcome: one remaining task may constrain reliability or be the service the customer values. This helps separate average task performance from the failure that makes a completed workflow unacceptable.
qualification: Economic scenario discussion, not evidence of a universal weakest-link formula or a settled legal liability model.
